# MID PENN BANK HIRES ZACH LOVE AS COMMERCIAL LOAN OFFICER


Posted on Sep 21st, 2026


Millersburg, Pa. – September 21, 2026. Mid Penn Bank (the “Bank”), a wholly-owned subsidiary of Mid Penn Bancorp, Inc. (“Mid Penn”) (NASDAQ: MPB), is pleased to announce that Zach Love has joined the Bank as vice president and commercial loan officer. Love will support commercial lending efforts throughout the Lancaster region and work with businesses on their lending and financing needs. He will report to Justin Manning, senior vice president and regional president.


Love brings more than a decade of banking experience to Mid Penn. Most recently, he served as a business and consumer lender at Ephrata National Bank, where he developed lending relationships with small business and consumer clients throughout the Lancaster area. Prior to that, Love spent five years with PNC Bank as vice president and business banker III, building relationships with local businesses and assisting with their lending and deposit needs. Earlier in his career, he held branch management roles with Union Community Bank and PNC Bank and gained experience in relationship management, business development and branch operations.


Love earned a Bachelor of Arts degree in political science from Lock Haven University of Pennsylvania. He serves on the Economic Development and Planning Committee of Lancaster City Alliance and on the board of directors for Leadership Lancaster. He previously served on the board of directors for The Common Wheel and as a Lancaster Chamber ambassador. He was also a co-founder of Lancaster P.A.T.H.


### **About Mid Penn Bank**


Mid Penn Bank, headquartered in Millersburg, Pennsylvania, has been serving the community since 1868. The Bank operates 62 retail locations throughout Pennsylvania and central and southern New Jersey, and has total assets of approximately $7 billion. Mid Penn offers a comprehensive portfolio of financial products and services to meet the banking needs of the communities it serves. To learn more, please visit[www.midpennbank.com](https://www.midpennbank.com/) .
